tools.name: device_list
tools.description: List the hardware devices of this computer: an identifier, a category, a name and the bound kernel driver for each. Serial numbers and addresses are never included.

categories.description: Only list devices of these categories. Leave out to list every device.

tools.name: device_get
tools.description: Show everything known about one device, by the identifier that device_list returned. Serial numbers and addresses are redacted.

tools.name: device_get_inventory
tools.description: Show the whole hardware inventory: the computer model and firmware, every device, firmware update status and which sources could not be read. Serial numbers and addresses are redacted.

tools.name: device_list_problems
tools.description: List hardware problems: devices with no driver, drivers that did not attach, firmware files that could not be loaded. Each has an error code, a message, a suggested next step and technical detail.
